states.meaning: A trusted stable release candidate was discovered, but download has not started.
Bytes are being fetched; progress is not verification and not installation.
The byte count matched the trusted expected size, but no APK trust claim is allowed yet.
All source, ABI, size, SHA-256, package, version, SDK and signer checks passed.
The user explicitly authorized handoff for this exact verified candidate in this process.
The verified file was handed to the trusted system installer; installation is not confirmed.
External PackageManager readback exactly matches target package, versionCode, versionName and signer set.
Installer returned or process restarted without enough external evidence to confirm or classify the install.
A specified trust, transfer or installer failure occurred with a user-visible reason.
The user explicitly cancelled the download/install or the installer reported user cancellation.

transitions.guard: C01-C09 passed and a unique ABI-compatible asset was selected
Remote stable version is not newer; expose up-to-date state
Transfer is complete and actual byte count equals trusted expected size
Network, range, source identity, storage or completeness failure
C02, C07, C09 and C11-C18 pass in order
Any integrity, package, version, ABI payload or signer check fails
Fresh explicit action for this exact verified candidate
Exactly one trusted system installer and valid provider URI
packageName, longVersionCode, versionName and signer set exactly match target
System installer explicitly reports user cancellation

restartPolicy.action: Validate persisted source identity and range validators; resume only when still identical.
restartPolicy.fallback: Restart from zero or FAILED; never jump to VERIFIED.
FAILED and remove corrupted candidate; never trust persisted unverified state.

restartPolicy.action: Rehash and reread current installed baseline before another handoff.
restartPolicy.fallback: FAILED or return to DOWNLOADED_UNVERIFIED as applicable.

restartPolicy.action: Drop stale authorization and return to VERIFIED.
Read installed package identity from PackageManager.
restartPolicy.fallback: Exact match becomes INSTALL_CONFIRMED; otherwise INSTALL_UNKNOWN unless explicit installer status says CANCELLED/FAILED.

invariants: VERIFIED never implies user authorization or installer handoff.
INSTALL_CONFIRMED requires external exact package/version/signer readback.
No installer launch, timeout, poll, generic version increase or optimistic UI can satisfy INSTALL_CONFIRMED.
Existing installation remains intact when any pre-handoff trust check fails.
